statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail is elevated during U.S. power hour as available NQ data remain near the session low after the delayed post-Warsh downside leg.
recommendation: The mapped state reflects elevated path risk through the cash close; further escalation depends on continued near-low holding, shallow or failed rebounds and broader cross-asset confirmation.
headline: Power-hour downside structure lifts Tail into the elevated band
body: Available NQ data show the September contract roughly 0.7% below the prior close and near the lower end of its session range after a delayed post-Warsh selloff. Front-end Treasury yields remain firmer and semiconductor weakness persists, but VIX near 14.7 and mixed megacap performance limit evidence of a fully aligned one-way regime.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail was mostly low-to-watch while Stress rose into the extreme band ahead of and around Jackson Hole. Tail briefly reached 27% at 17:00 UTC as a delayed downside leg emerged, then eased to 22% at 18:00 UTC as the path showed partial retracement.
outlookSummary: Risk is concentrated in the remaining U.S. power hour and cash close. If near-low holding and shallow rebounds persist with firm yields and technology weakness, Tail can remain elevated; a durable rebound would lower it. After the Friday futures close, active path risk falls and weekend headline/gap risk becomes dominant.
